Finding the right pair of kicks for young runners means balancing lightweight comfort, durability for the playground, and actual support for movement.

According to recent field and gear tests featured on [Live for the Outdoors](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/) , here are the top-performing kids' running and active shoes for 2026, broken down by what they do best:[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)

- **Top All-Rounder — [Asics GT-1000 14 GS Junior](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462530643620583,imageDocid:12997465709006124466,gpcid:14733887264493574762,headlineOfferDocid:11266473064204718882,catalogid:8493949216009655650,productDocid:15654953756301397339,rds:PC_14733887264493574762%7CPROD_PC_14733887264493574762&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQAw)** : Features reliable gel cushioning and a breathable, airy engineered mesh upper. It is widely praised as a go-to daily trainer that handles school PE, pavement, and casual sprinting with ease.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best All-Road / Off-Road — [Hoka Speedgoat 6 Junior](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462781087475816,imageDocid:910053436129485925,gpcid:1641666523150628965,headlineOfferDocid:7296018777839639189,catalogid:8697817955903575460,productDocid:10455766832356059856,rds:PC_1641666523150628965%7CPROD_PC_1641666523150628965&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQCQ)** : Crowned best in test for mixed terrain. It comes equipped with deep, aggressive lugs for grip, a supportive EVA midsole, and a tough mesh upper that won't give out after a week of mud-crawling.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best Value — [Skechers Selectors - Reset Achieved](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462576003015248,imageDocid:17896174082944644025,gpcid:775888052812936868,headlineOfferDocid:6731498962022204828,catalogid:3636476131147467638,productDocid:12405609639348157478,rds:PC_5072704648025450894%7CPROD_PC_5072704648025450894&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQDw)** : A great budget-friendly pick offering all-day comfort, an easy slip-on build, and an accommodating EVA midsole for kids who just want to throw them on and go.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best for Dedicated Trail Running — [Salomon Speedcross Junior](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,imageDocid:15023352134214481318,gpcid:17517057442598568601,headlineOfferDocid:15632309352122526437,catalogid:11045739972166598428,productDocid:12765808722896933615,rds:PC_10811686004228467720%7CPROD_PC_10811686004228467720&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQFQ)** : Built with a high-traction Contagrip outsole and a fast-adjusting Quicklace system, making it ideal for young cross-country runners or kids hitting dirt paths.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best for Pure Comfort — [Hoka Clifton 10 Junior](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462538223289623,imageDocid:11601990696244261741,gpcid:15601941207460875669,headlineOfferDocid:7540079900905208534,catalogid:15633241734248302267,productDocid:2566439231224139164,rds:PC_15601941207460875669%7CPROD_PC_15601941207460875669&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQGw)** : Delivers plush, cloud-like cushioning paired with a smooth rocker-shaped sole that encourages an easy, natural rolling stride.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best Lightweight Everyday — [Under Armour Surge](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462563900947141,imageDocid:10014086193541143706,gpcid:14216859174634643335,headlineOfferDocid:1994017165102563819,catalogid:1342546656420821154,productDocid:17039329487224364546,rds:PC_12394922154328195209%7CPROD_PC_12394922154328195209&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQIQ)** : Features a chunky EVA midsole for impact absorption and a streamlined, durable tread that holds up well to daily abuse.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
- **Best Adventure Workhorse — [Adidas Terrex Agravic BOA RAIN.RDY Junior](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462915982046869,imageDocid:16849247394171109303,gpcid:8042782521909400503,headlineOfferDocid:14717250974530309435,catalogid:9757757836239603093,productDocid:1010427097344439392,rds:PC_12396134966066112867%7CPROD_PC_12396134966066112867&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwie5LXA34KYAxVym_0HHXAUKlIQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQJw)** : Combines a weather-protective build with a micro-adjustable BOA lacing system for a locked-in fit that keeps out water and debris.[[1]](https://www.livefortheoutdoors.com/trail-running/shoes/best-kids-running-shoes/)
